items.name: use-table-state
items.title: useTableState
items.description: URL-synced table state hook: page, pageSize, sort, dir, search query, and arbitrary filters. Makes every table shareable and bookmarkable; pass straight into a server-side fetcher.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: StatCard
items.description: KPI card with value, label, optional trend (up/down/neutral with coloured arrow), icon slot, sparkline slot, and a built-in loading skeleton. Drop a row of these on every dashboard.

items.name: column-header
items.title: ColumnHeader (sortable table header)
items.description: Sortable table column header with direction indicator and a small dropdown for Ascending / Descending / Hide. Pairs with useTableState for URL-driven sort.

items.name: data-table-toolbar
items.title: DataTableToolbar
items.description: Standard toolbar shown above every DataTable: search input, faceted filter buttons (multi-select with badge counts), column-visibility toggle, export button, reset, and slot for primary actions.

items.name: bulk-actions-bar
items.title: BulkActionsBar
items.description: Floating action bar at the bottom of the viewport, visible when rows are selected. Shows count, action slots, and a clear button. Auto-hides at zero selection; Escape clears.

items.name: server-table-fetcher
items.title: fetchTable (server-side table handler)
items.description: Bundles the standard moves every list API route needs: parse + validate search params with a Zod schema, build a Prisma where via buildPrismaWhere, build an orderBy, run findMany + count in parallel, return the { data, total, page, pageSize, totalPages } shape usePaginatedQuery expects.

items.name: editable-cell
items.title: EditableCell (inline-edit + optimistic save)
items.description: Inline-edit table cell. Click to enter edit mode, Enter to commit, Esc to cancel. Optimistic update with rollback on error. Validate fn + spinner + skip-unchanged. Drop into any TanStack Table cell renderer.
